heroQuote: Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness
heroSub: Interesting thoughts are the most faithful travel companion. Here we setup a lodging for all of them.
footerQuote: “Travel is fatal to prejudice, bigotry, and narrow-mindedness” — Mark Twain
introText: Wandering Husky is a travel journal and photo archive — years of life on the road, from the American West to the Serengeti to the Dolomites. Thoughts we left behind, and thoughts we brought back.
shenmaTeaser: The site is named after Shenma — the husky who started it all, and the most faithful travel companion.
